title: Readable complete exports and archives
acceptance_scenarios: Export notes, addenda, attachments, consent and required metadata. Reconcile counts/checksums and open the archive independently of the current service; test representative format migrations.
evidence_after_implementation: A06-synthetic-export.zip; manifest.csv; schema-and-format-guide.pdf; A06-independent-read-test.pdf; signed custody/exit terms.
manual_acceptance: Receiving custodian witnesses readability and completeness. Refresh on export/schema/format changes; periodically rehearse retrieval and key preservation. A successful export is not a statutory national-interface submission.
history_policy: Do not invent legacy consent times, rewrite existing clinical seals, or record mock authority responses as real acceptance.
implemented_controls: Restricted manager archive exports patient-linked healthcare/BHYT records, linked files, readable HTML, JSON and per-file SHA-256 manifest. Clinical integrity is verified before publication. Unsupported models and scope limits are explicit.
remaining_actions: Reconcile the exported model inventory, fields, binary evidence, financial/chatter/external records and approved form set before calling an archive complete. PDF/PDF-A archival profiles and external records remain additional work where applicable.
